_comment: Agronomic crop definitions for FarmSim. Owned by the Gameplay Programmer (crops). Market prices live in economy config, NOT here. Every value here is tunable without touching code (NFR-006).

stages.teaching_note: Seed needs steady moisture to sprout. Dry soil now means gaps in the stand that never recover.
The plant is building leaves. It is fairly forgiving here — short dry spells can be tolerated.
The single most water-critical stage for maize. Stress during tasselling causes poor pollination and badly filled cobs.
Kernels are packing on weight. Water shortage now directly shrinks the harvest.
The crop is drying down for harvest. Extra water is no longer useful.
Beans rot easily in waterlogged soil at planting. Moist, not soaked.
Beans fix their own nitrogen, which is why they are a good rotation partner for maize.
Water stress at flowering makes the plant drop its flowers, and a dropped flower is a pod you will never harvest.
Pods are filling out. Steady moisture now decides how many beans are in each pod.
Pods are drying. Hold off on watering to avoid mould.
Cabbage seed is small and sits shallow. Keep the top of the soil damp or the stand comes up patchy.
The plant is building the frame of outer leaves that will feed the head later. It forgives a short dry spell here.
The head is forming and the plant drinks hardest now. Let it dry at this stage and the head stays small and loose.
The head is firm. Cut it now - left standing too long, cabbage heads split.

_sprites._comment: Where each crop's art lives in game/objects/basic_plants.png. 16x16 cells. Column 0 is the seed packet and column 5 the harvested item; columns 1-4 are the growth art. Swap these numbers when the real asset pack lands - no code changes needed.
